Title: Azure Stack integration with Azure Government Secret cloud

Body.Content:
Work is in progress to allow Azure Stack operators in government organizations to connect their Azure Stacks to the Azure Government Secret cloud for identity, Pay-As-You-Go billing, marketplace syndication, and hybrid scenarios. This will provide a higher level of information security and compliance.

Read more information and Check back with this blog as work progresses.

Learn more about the Azure Government Secret cloud
